Title: Agent Initialization
Description: LABOR agent created to monitor employment as master variable for systemic stress transmission. Employment break triggers conversion of latent stress across all domains (CARL consumer, REGINALD banks, HENRY markets).

Title: Federal Employment Cuts Untracked
Description: DOGE (Musk-led) is actively cutting federal agencies but no systematic tracking exists. USAID effectively eliminated, CFPB gutted, DOE/EPA/IRS targeted. 2.2M federal civilian + ~5M contractors at risk. This is a direct employment shock with multiplier effects.

Title: Employment Thesis - Leading Indicators
Description: Employment breaks in sequence: (1) job postings decline (6+ mo), (2) temp employment declines (3-6 mo), (3) hours cut (1-3 mo), (4) claims rise (weeks), (5) NFP misses (coincident), (6) unemployment rises (lag). LABOR's value is detecting sequence early.
Notes: Track the sequence not just headline

Title: REGINALD Employment Trigger
Description: Per REGINALD Session 004: "If ANY employment metric reaches RED → all ORANGE banks escalate simultaneously." Employment break is THE catalyst for bank stress transmission. Claims >300K or unemployment >5.0% triggers this.

Title: HENRY Structural Bid Break
Description: Per HENRY analysis: Employment shock causes 401(k) outflows, reversing structural bid. Unemployment >5.0% is scenario trigger for market repricing as passive flows reverse.

Title: CARL Consumer Transmission
Description: Per CARL: Consumer stress LEADS banking stress by 6-18 months. Employment break accelerates this: Layoffs → income loss → missed payments → delinquency → default. 1-3 month timeline from job loss to first missed payment.

Title: Quits Rate Declining
Description: Quits rate at 2.0% is below pre-pandemic normal of 2.3% and well below Great Resignation peak of 3.0%. Workers less confident about finding new jobs. Leading indicator of labor market cooling.

Title: CRITICAL: December 2025 NFP Only +50K
Description: December 2025 NFP was +50,000 — extremely weak. Full year 2025 averaged only 49K/month vs 168K/month in 2024. This is a MASSIVE deceleration. Retail trade lost 25K jobs. Federal government employment down 277K (-9.2%) since January 2025.

Title: Part-Time Economic Reasons +980K YoY
Description: Part-time for economic reasons at 5.3 million, up 980,000 over the year. This is hidden unemployment — people who want full-time work but can't find it. Breaching 5.0M threshold.

Title: Long-Term Unemployed +397K YoY
Description: Long-term unemployed (27+ weeks) at 1.9 million, up 397,000 over the year. Now 26% of all unemployed. Rising LTU is a lagging but confirming indicator.

Title: Federal Employment -277K Since January
Description: CRITICAL: Federal government employment down 277,000 or 9.2% since January 2025. This is DOGE impact showing up in official data. Direct employment shock confirmed.
Notes: DOGE impact now in official data

Title: Job Openings Down 885K YoY
Description: Job openings at 7.1 million in November, down 885,000 over the year. Openings/unemployed ratio declining. Labor market cooling confirmed.

Title: Average Workweek Down to 34.2 Hours
Description: Average workweek edged down 0.1 hour to 34.2 hours in December. Companies cut hours before layoffs. This is a leading indicator flashing.

Title: BLS Commissioner Fired After Weak Report
Description: Trump fired BLS Commissioner after weak December jobs report, nominating Brett Matsumoto as replacement. Political interference in employment statistics — data integrity concern.

Title: Large Corporate Layoffs Continuing
Description: Per Will: Numerous large company layoffs being reported. Layoffs.fyi now tracking both tech layoffs AND DOGE/federal layoffs. Need to aggregate Q4 2025 / Q1 2026 data.
